Telemus Capital Has Lifted Apple (AAPL) Stake By $9.68 Million; Zevenbergen Capital Investments Raised Its 2U (TWOU) Position
May 8, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Telemus Capital Llc increased Apple Inc (AAPL) stake by 68.45% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Telemus Capital Llc acquired 57,270 shares as Apple Inc (AAPL)’s stock declined 3.81%. The Telemus Capital Llc holds 140,935 shares with $23.85 million value, up from 83,665 last quarter. Apple Inc now has $938.34 billion valuation. The stock decreased 0.12% or $0.229 during the last trading session, reaching $184.931. About 6.93M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.

(TWOU)’s stock rose 34.60%. The Zevenbergen Capital Investments Llc holds 1.01M shares with $64.89M value, up from 982,015 last quarter. 2U Inc. now has $4.84B valuation.
